notes.title: Free Seaside Adventure DLC Available Now!
notes.notes:
[h2]Sun, sand, and girls[/h2]
have entered the mystic world of Element X!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38809266/6e892b28275fce2da80f905eaca53cf50aaa326e.jpg[/img]
[h2]Meet[/h2]
[list]
[*] Tachibana Yuuri - friendly next door big sister who comes to the beach for delicious dinner ingredients! Her favorite dish is the neighbourhood’s famous takoyakis, often made exclusively for her little brother (with love)!
[*] Aomori Azusa - heartbroken schoolgirl that fails to capture a certain classmate’s attention. She’s at the beach trying to release her anger by taking it out on pesky marine creatures.
[*] Momoko - a long time stray cat until one friendly guy adopted her and gave her the best home she could have. Sadly, during one particularly disastrous day when sea creatures invaded the beach, she was separated from her owner. She has to fight for her way back.
[/list]
[h2]New Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] Hand drawn, animated player skins of Tachibana, Aomori and Momoko!
[*] New enemy skins of adorable pink octopi!
[*] Enhanced lighting and map features including palm tree and the ocean!
[/list]
[h2] Darkness Edition Exclusive[/h2]
[list]
[*] Player skins have unique variations that come with the Darkness Edition DLC!
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38809266/7ca697463f70fc81fc6eae6dc187a1c869fe4311.jpg[/img]

Download today!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1450140/Element_X_Seaside_Adventure/

notes.title: Dev-Stream and Upcoming DLC!!
notes.notes:
Aerobox Games is a small indie studio with 4.5 members, and we are very happy to be able to release Element X as our first project! 

Big thanks to everybody that supported us through this process, especially those that have purchased a copy of the game, the Darkness Edition, and those that have left a review!

[b]Exciting news![/b]
On October 20th, 2020 6pm PST (today), we’ll be participating in a dev-stream about the development of Element X. 
The stream will take place on Twitch hosted by [url=https://www.twitch.tv/glasseyetiger/videos]GlassEyeTiger[/url].

Come hang out and learn about Element X behind the scenes!

[b]More exciting news! [/b]
A [b]NEW DLC[/b] is currently in beta, and we’ll be revealing the details during the steam. You’ll see a showcase of some of the DLC artworks as well a live demo! 

Stay tuned!
